title: Reshape and Recur: Improving SSMs with Input Reshaping and Depth Recurrence
abstract: arXiv:2605.16048v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: State Space Models (SSMs) are increasingly deployed in the Edge because they offer, at comparable performance, a smaller memory/training/inference footprint, compared to Large Language Models (LLMs). These three advantages are a direct consequence of the time recurrence inherent in the SSMs architecture. Here, we further improve this recurrent architecture by positively answering two previously underexplored, orthogonal questions: (1) Can we reduce SSMs memory-footprint without any performance penalty, by also employing depth recurrence? (2) Can we increase SSMs performance by using a fixed and consistent time-granularity across all tasks? The first question is somewhat unexpected, given that SSMs are already recurrent. However, the orthogonal depth recurrence further decreases SSMs memory footprint. We show that a looped SSM with $k$ parameters adaptively iterated $M$ times, achieves a performance comparable to a standard SSM

translated_title: 重塑与递归：通过输入重塑和深度递归改进状态空间模型
translated_abstract: 状态空间模型（SSMs）越来越多地被部署在边缘设备上，因为与大语言模型（LLMs）相比，它们在性能相当的情况下具有更小的内存/训练/推理占用。这三个优势是SSMs架构中固有的时间递归的直接结果。在本文中，我们通过肯定地回答两个先前探索不足且相互正交的问题，进一步改进了这种递归架构：（1）我们能否通过同时采用深度递归，在不损失任何性能的情况下减少SSMs的内存占用？（2）我们能否通过在所有任务中使用固定且一致的时间粒度来提高SSMs的性能？考虑到SSMs本身已经是递归的，第一个问题有些出人意料。然而，正交的深度递归进一步降低了SSMs的内存占用。我们证明了一个具有 $k$ 参数的循环SSM在自适应迭代 $M$ 次后，可以达到与标准SSM相当的性能。
tldr: 本文通过引入输入重塑（在所有任务中使用固定一致的时间粒度）和深度递归（自适应循环迭代）两项正交改进，在不损失性能的前提下进一步降低了状态空间模型的内存占用并提升了其性能。
en_tdlr: This paper improves SSMs by introducing two orthogonal techniques—input reshaping with a fixed and consistent time granularity across tasks, and depth recurrence with adaptive looped iterations—which further reduces memory footprint without performance loss while enhancing performance.
